statement: Using all MUTAG and ENZYMES graphs, pairwise CDOT/FGW distances, an RBF kernel, and nested stratified 10-fold/5-fold CV, CDOT exceeds FGW on MUTAG (0.8617 vs 0.8249) and ENZYMES (0.5133 vs 0.4450).
acceptance_obligations: hash and parse all 188 MUTAG and 600 ENZYMES graphs
compute every unordered pair at every published alpha
use provided labels or attributes and normalized geodesic geometry
jointly tune alpha, C, and gamma inside five-fold training-only CV
report every held-out fold for three disclosed outer seeds
independently recompute means and seedwise directions
show label-permutation controls near chance and below main performance
falsification_rule: A stable CDOT<FGW direction on either named dataset under every disclosed outer seed, with all integrity gates passing, contradicts the claim's conjunction.
non_circularity: Dataset scale, alpha/C/gamma grids, folds, and all seeds are fixed before results; no seed or hyperparameter is selected from the reported direction.
